metadata.question: Did nitrogen oxide concentrations in the Northern Hemisphere increase from 2019 to 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P (TROPOMI) provides NO2 (nitrogen dioxide) data globally - Date: Compare 2019 vs 2020 - Location: Northern Hemisphere (latitude > 0) - Need to compare mean NO2 concentrations between the two years 2. Masking strategy: - Sentinel-5P NO2 data already has quality filtering built-in - Apply QA value filtering to ensure valid pixels - No cloud masking needed as Sentinel-5P is not optical 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check collection size for both years - Check valid pixel count after QA filtering - Compare mean NO2 values; if either is None/NaN or negative (invalid), output C3 - If both years have valid data, compare: if 2020 > 2019, answer A; otherwise B ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Northern Hemisphere nh_geometry = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, 0, 180, 90]) # 2. Data Acquisition for 2019 col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \ .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') \ .filterBounds(nh_geometry) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('qa_value', 0.5)) # QA filtering size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo() print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}") if size_2019 == 0: print("No Sentinel-5P data for 2019 in Northern Hemisphere.") print("C1") exit() # 3. Data Acquisition for 2020 col_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \ .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2020-12-31') \ .filterBounds(nh_geometry) \ .filter(ee.Filter.lt('qa_value', 0.5)) # QA filtering size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo() print(f"2020 Images: {size_2020}") if size_2020 == 0: print("No Sentinel-5P data for 2020 in Northern Hemisphere.") print("C1") exit() # 4. Calculate mean NO2 for 2019 img_2019 = col_2019.mean() count_2019 = img_2019.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=nh_geometry, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() if count_2019 == 0: print("No valid pixels for 2019 after QA filtering.") print("C2") exit() mean_2019 = img_2019.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=nh_geometry, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() # 5. Calculate mean NO2 for 2020 img_2020 = col_2020.mean() count_2020 = img_2020.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=nh_geometry, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() if count_2020 == 0: print("No valid pixels for 2020 after QA filtering.") print("C2") exit() mean_2020 = img_2020.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=nh_geometry, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo() # 6. Validation & Final Answer print(f"2019 Mean NO2: {mean_2019:.4e} mol/m2 (Pixels: {int(count_2019)})") print(f"2020 Mean NO2: {mean_2020:.4e} mol/m2 (Pixels: {int(count_2020)})") if mean_2019 is None or mean_2020 is None or \ mean_2019 < 0 or mean_2020 < 0: print("C3") elif mean_2020 > mean_2019: print("Increase: {:.2%}".format((mean_2020 - mean_2019) / mean_2019)) print("A") else: print("Decrease: {:.2%}".format((mean_2019 - mean_2020) / mean_2019)) print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Northern Hemisphere
nh_geometry = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-180, 0, 180, 90])

# 2. Data Acquisition for 2019
col_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \
    .filterDate('2019-01-01', '2019-12-31') \
    .filterBounds(nh_geometry) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('qa_value', 0.5))  # QA filtering

size_2019 = col_2019.size().getInfo()
print(f"2019 Images: {size_2019}")

if size_2019 == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-5P data for 2019 in Northern Hemisphere.")
    print("C1")
    exit()

# 3. Data Acquisition for 2020
col_2020 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI_NO2') \
    .filterDate('2020-01-01', '2020-12-31') \
    .filterBounds(nh_geometry) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('qa_value', 0.5))  # QA filtering

size_2020 = col_2020.size().getInfo()
print(f"2020 Images: {size_2020}")

if size_2020 == 0:
    print("No Sentinel-5P data for 2020 in Northern Hemisphere.")
    print("C1")
    exit()

# 4. Calculate mean NO2 for 2019
img_2019 = col_2019.mean()
count_2019 = img_2019.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=nh_geometry,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()

if count_2019 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels for 2019 after QA filtering.")
    print("C2")
    exit()

mean_2019 = img_2019.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=nh_geometry,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()

# 5. Calculate mean NO2 for 2020
img_2020 = col_2020.mean()
count_2020 = img_2020.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=nh_geometry,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()

if count_2020 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels for 2020 after QA filtering.")
    print("C2")
    exit()

mean_2020 = img_2020.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=nh_geometry,
    scale=5000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('NO2_column_number_density').getInfo()

# 6. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"2019 Mean NO2: {mean_2019:.4e} mol/m2 (Pixels: {int(count_2019)})")
print(f"2020 Mean NO2: {mean_2020:.4e} mol/m2 (Pixels: {int(count_2020)})")

if mean_2019 is None or mean_2020 is None or \
   mean_2019 < 0 or mean_2020 < 0:
    print("C3")
elif mean_2020 > mean_2019:
    print("Increase: {:.2%}".format((mean_2020 - mean_2019) / mean_2019))
    print("A")
else:
    print("Decrease: {:.2%}".format((mean_2019 - mean_2020) / mean_2019))
    print("B")
